_comment: Declarative plan for splitting the workspace test run across CI runners.
Every shard issues the identical package selection
(--workspace --exclude opc-persist --all-features) and differs only in
cargo TARGET filters. Package selection is what drives feature
unification under resolver = 2, so keeping it identical keeps every
dependency compiled exactly as the single-job run compiled it: a
--test/--lib/--doc filter selects which units are built and run, never
which features they are built with.
Ordinary target weights round up the slowest outer-harness time across 13
main runs on 2026-10-19/20, including isolated commands for that target.
Unlisted measured targets took at most default_weight; future targets use it too.
Fixed weights reserve attached library work (545s on it-0, 461s on it-1).
The full recovery_profile took 2451s. Its named group includes the longest
crossed-rekey test and is estimated at 1900s; the remainder is estimated at
1300s. Reserve 800s for compilation/setup (observed max 781s), placing the
longest lane near 75% of the unchanged 60m cap. Remeasure on hosted CI.
All recovery matrices keep their original four-thread profile and bounds.
The full-window portable snapshot proofs run alone in checked O1 and retain their literal row counts and operation guards.
Long-running fleet tests are named explicitly so they can run on
separate runners. The 'misc' shard runs the same target with every
named test skipped, so a newly added test in this file is never lost:
it lands in 'misc' automatically.

_lib_groups_comment: Exact names keep moved groups disjoint from misc and from isolated timing contracts.
New unlisted tests still run on misc. Precheck rejects missing or ambiguous names.
Ignored subprocess helpers declare one enabled parent in their group; the parent owns their crash scenarios.
Each full-bound store proof has a dedicated native-log shard and uses serial test O1 with debug checks enabled.
The full-journal opt-in proof stays ignored; do not turn it into a hosted qualification.
Verification-budget proofs run in separate ordinary-profile processes on heavy-0.
Shared process admissions run in fresh exact-name processes; group splits retain their original Cargo profiles. The ordinary parallel remainder keeps four test threads.
